products.name: Agent Foundry
products.description: Framework for building, grounding, and orchestrating domain-specific agents across commerce workflows. Provides standardized tools for data access, schema alignment, reasoning patterns, memory, and safety layers.

products.name: Commerce Knowledge Graph
products.description: Unified graph connecting product, customer, transaction, inventory, and operational data. Remembers, reasons and acts across every conversation, order, stock movement, invoice and ticket.

products.name: hoppr
products.description: Enterprise commerce intelligence agent. Connects Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, GA4 & more; asks questions in natural language; gets trusted answers grounded in business data.

products.name: All-e
products.description: Conversational sales agent for general trade. AI sales agent for distributors, retailers and field sales teams. Voice, WhatsApp & Photo-to-Cart ordering; applies pricing, schemes & credit policies; creates ERP-ready orders.

products.name: Extract
products.description: Automated data pipeline for eCommerce. Connects to Shopee, Lazada, Meta Ads, Shopify, Amazon, Zepto; delivers clean structured data to Sheets, Excel, Snowflake, or own database.

products.name: Chattr
products.description: Customer support agent for commerce. Handles queries, order tracking, returns, and product recommendations.

products.name: Cartlyst
products.description: B2B order specialist agent. Handles order capture, scheme management, and credit checks for distributors and retailers.

products.name: Turbo
products.description: Brings together sales, advertising, inventory, and operations data in one unified view.

products.name: Data Connectors
products.description: Connectors to marketplaces, D2C platforms, ad platforms, CRM, and ERP systems. AES-256 encrypted, ISO 27001 & SOC-2 certified, GDPR & PDPA compliant.

legal.description: ISO 27001:2022 certified, SOC-2 certified, GDPR compliant, PDPA compliant. Data Processing Agreement available. Data Protection Officer appointed. AES-256 encryption, no raw data stored beyond delivery.
